description: This file defines the 'AmbiguousSuccessParser' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling certain ambiguous successful responses from S3 operations. It converts certain 200 status code responses into retryable errors, enabling better error handling for multipart upload operations.

classes.name: AmbiguousSuccessParser
classes.description: A parser class that handles ambiguous success responses from S3, converting certain response codes into retryable errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the parser with custom parsing, error parsing functions, and exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser, checking for specific successful responses and translating certain errors into exceptions.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of member data from a stream to the underlying parser.
